candidats.titre: File:Cylindrical masonry watchtower along western wall, Ribat Tit - El Jadida, Morocco - Oct 2026.jpg
candidats.description: A detailed close-up view of a semi-circular, crenellated coastal watchtower along the western seaward ramparts of Ribat Tit (Moulay Abdellah Amghar) near El Jadida, Morocco. Constructed using traditional rubble masonry and mortar, this tower features crenellations and narrow observation slits designed to monitor maritime activity along the Atlantic coast. Built in the 12th century under the Amghar dynasty, such towers formed an essential part of the ribat's defensive perimeter.
